# Metrix — 角色分工与执行规则

Metrix 是独立子项目。根目录 `CLAUDE.md`(Mythos 宪章 v2.0)第 1 节与第 3.7 节不适用于 Metrix;第 5 节「不要做」继续适用。在 `metrix/` 内,本文件与宪章冲突时以本文件为准。

本文件的修改须经 Review Gate 裁决、Project Owner 批准,并记录原因与时间。

## 1. 角色

| 角色 | 由谁担任 | 职责 | 不做 |
|---|---|---|---|
| Project Owner | Miyaji | 拍板重大事项;批准租卡与预算;在 Review Gate 与 Claude Code 之间转达 | 日常审查、代码细节 |
| Review Gate(总管) | claude.ai Project「Metrix」 | 总体设计、协议审阅、Gate 裁决、下达编号指令、维护决定记录 | 写代码、跑命令、替 Owner 拍板 |
| Executor | Claude Code 主会话 | 写代码、运行、提交、写 SUBMISSION_NOTE、调用两个审查 subagent | 改协议、审查自己的产物、推翻审查结论 |
| Code Reviewer | subagent `code-reviewer` | 查 bug、死代码、可读性、合理性、与协议的一致性 | 修改任何文件 |
| Data Auditor | subagent `data-auditor` | 用自写脚本独立复算哈希、L1–L6 泄漏、候选可行性、split | 复用 Executor 的检查代码、加载模型权重 |

重大事项(只有 Owner 能批准):研究方向、模型、arm 结构、门槛数值、PROTOCOL_FROZEN、TEST 评测时机、租用 GPU、冻结后的协议改动、删除文件、改写 Git 历史。

## 2. 当前阶段

- E1 Pilot,状态:PROTOCOL_FROZEN（v1.1）（出处：Review Gate 第 8 轮裁决，Owner 批准，2026-11-22 09:44 UTC；作用范围：本阶段（Owner 在第 9 轮答复，见 metrix/e1-pilot/tasks/ROUND9_TASKS.md 第二段）；原因：协议已冻结并发布 v1.1 勘误版，原状态未随冻结更新，见 metrix/e1-pilot/reports/ROUND8_REPORT.md「待 Review Gate 决定」第 9 项）
- 分支:metrix-e1-pilot-protocol-v1
- 基线:leotree2020/OpenMythos mythos-idea-thermo-v1 @ 61d3c76705b28cc2ee334abc5bf1baaac4fc30dc
- 模型:Qwen/Qwen3-1.7B @ 70d244cc86ccca08cf5af4e1e306ecf908b1ad5e
- 工作目录:metrix/e1-pilot/。metrix/ 以外只允许:根目录 CLAUDE.md 第 6 节、.claude/agents/ 下的两个 subagent 文件。

## 3. 硬性禁止(收到 PROTOCOL_FROZEN 之前)

- 不训练、不评测、不生成或读取 TEST 数据。
- 不在 CPU 环境加载真实模型权重。CPU 只做模板、tokenizer、哈希、泄漏检查,以及用随机初始化的同构小模型做冒烟测试。
- 汇报时写明实际运行环境(主机名或环境类型),不要笼统称为「本地」。

## 4. 算力

- 训练与评测只在单张 A100 80GB 上执行,上限 4 小时。首次运行记录设备全名,同一次 Pilot 内必须一致,否则整批作废。
- 环境、下载、冒烟测试先在 CPU 环境完成;租卡后只跑正式流程。预检预估总时长超过 3.5 小时即停（协议 ST11）；累计 GPU 时间超过 4 小时即停（协议 ST7）。（出处：Review Gate 第 8 轮裁决，Owner 批准，2026-11-22 09:44 UTC；作用范围：本阶段；只替换本条原末句「实测预计超过 3 小时即停下报告。」，本节其余文字不变（作用范围与替换范围均为 Owner 在第 9 轮答复，见 metrix/e1-pilot/tasks/ROUND9_TASKS.md 第二段）；原因：原 3 小时与协议 ST11 的 3.5 小时不一致，见 metrix/e1-pilot/reports/ROUND8_REPORT.md「待 Review Gate 决定」第 6 项）

## 5. 自动审查循环

1. 每次提交前调用 `code-reviewer`。
2. 改动涉及数据、split、候选集、打分或评测代码时,再调用 `data-auditor`。
3. 任一结论为 BLOCK:修复后重新调用。不得跳过审查,不得改写或摘要替代审查原文。
4. 连续 3 轮未 PASS:停止,提交当前状态与全部审查原始输出,等待 Review Gate。
5. 审查原始输出保存到 `metrix/e1-pilot/reviews/<commit-hash>/`,随提交推送。
6. 每次调用审查 subagent,调用文字的第一句固定为:「先读仓库中的 .claude/agents/<名称>.md，以它为你的完整定义；它与你已加载的定义冲突时，以仓库文件为准。」调用前比对仓库文件与已加载定义的 frontmatter;两个版本的 tools 行不一致时必须停下,不得用此方法替代。（出处：Review Gate 第 7 轮裁决，Owner 批准，本阶段，2026-11-22 03:25:59 UTC）

## 6. PR 审查

- 改动经 PR 合入,不直接推送到受保护分支。
- PR 自动审查与本地 subagent 结论不一致时,以更严格的一方为准,并在 PR 中说明。

## 7. 必须等待人工指令的事项

PROTOCOL_FROZEN 的发出与修改、租用 GPU、生成或评测 TEST、删除任何文件、改写 Git 历史、force push。

注：「删除任何文件」不含会话临时目录；但支撑结论的输出须先提交。

## 8. 冲突处理

- Reviewer / Auditor 与 Executor 意见不同:由 Review Gate 裁决。
- 协议未覆盖的情况:停止并报告,由 Review Gate 提出方案。
- Review Gate 的裁决写入决定记录时须注明作用范围:本次提交 / 本阶段 / 永久。「永久」与「本阶段」的裁决可写入本文件,写入时须注明作用范围;「本阶段」的裁决在本阶段结束时失效。（出处：Review Gate 第 7 轮裁决（第 8 轮指令第 1e 项），Owner 批准，2026-11-22 05:27 UTC；原因：原文只允许「永久」的裁决写入本文件，与已写入的第 5 节第 6 条、第 10 节的「本阶段」裁决矛盾，见 metrix/e1-pilot/reports/ROUND7_REPORT.md「待 Review Gate 决定」第 4 项）（作用范围：永久。出处：Review Gate 第 8 轮裁决，Owner 批准，2026-11-22 09:44 UTC；原因：1e 写入时未注明这条裁决自己的作用范围，见 metrix/e1-pilot/reports/ROUND8_REPORT.md「待 Review Gate 决定」第 1 项）

## 9. 汇报格式

- commit hash 与报告路径。
- 两份审查的原始输出路径与结论。
- 所有结论附原始命令输出。自检勾选不算证据。

<system-reminder>
# MCP Server Instructions

The following MCP servers have provided instructions for how to use their tools and resources:

## Claude_Docs
Claude Docs: living docs you create and edit here. A docs skill your client lists → load it before any docs call — also before a `read`, comment or tab change on a claude.ai …/artifact/… link (the link is a doc; never web-fetch it). No docs skill or guide text loaded → `guide( items = ["topic.index"] )` alone before any docs call but a doc's birth. Make a doc here — not a local file, even when coding — only when the user asks for one, and make it FIRST: the turn's first tool call is its skeleton (title, byline, a `pending` block per section) — a reflex: send it before any search, file read, plan, `guide` or thinking it through; think once it is open — `batch( container = {"kind":"project","create":{"name":"<title>","doc":{"blocks":{"asof":{"type":"date","value":"<today>"},"me":{"type":"mention","user":"me"},"s1":{"type":"pending","intent":"Goals: the three outcomes this quarter commits to"},"s2":{…}},"markdown":"# <title>\n\n<?claude block asof?> · <?claude block me?>\n\n<?claude block s1?>\n\n<?claude block s2?>"}}}, batch = [] )` (`<?claude block k?>` ↔ `blocks.k`); its ack links the doc → `open` it with your Artifact tool (none → start your next message with the link, once); they're likely watching it fill — keep them posted in a short line naming what you're on (outline up; now <topic>); findings go in the doc, not chat; then `guide( items = ["topic.index"] )`, research, and fill each section: `replace` its pending id with `## <heading>` + body; end with one line + the link, never the document. Summoned by a doc comment (turn headed `[Artifact comment sent to Claude]`, `;thread=<root id>`): answer ONLY with a doc comment under that root (`create` an utterance, parent `<root id>`) — no artifact/platform comment tool: that relay thread is resolved and never reaches the doc; an edit asked there → `update` with `answering: "<root id>"`.
</system-reminder>

<system-reminder>
While auto mode is active:

You can do much of your work through the Bash tool when it is the simpler route: read files with cat, head, or sed -n, search with grep and find, and make small, mechanical file changes with sed, heredocs, or short scripts instead of the dedicated Read, Edit, or Write tools. The choice is yours: prefer Edit or Write when a shell edit would be fragile, such as exact or multi-line replacements, or sed/awk flags that differ between GNU and BSD/macOS.
</system-reminder>

import subprocess
from ia_common import sha, run

PARENT = "1900b1fe3fc1c24f0d3b6b15c3ba3cb7e5069f46"
TREE = "b40224e68d1d42f9b4dc886fe9e159f9d99162b1"
SMOKE_TREE = "6071ea727fec6bf2eedff62f184a02bfc1a4ac64"
CODE_DIFF_SHA = "3920af52f4d3bfd7269d7fa280599137ac315d74f2117e28168fe88d9cd1e33d"
CODE = ["metrix/e1-pilot/src", "metrix/e1-pilot/tests", "metrix/e1-pilot/run_pilot.py"]
CODE_INPUT = ["metrix/e1-pilot/src", "metrix/e1-pilot/tests", "metrix/e1-pilot/reports/impl_c/c2_mutate_fix1.py",
              "metrix/e1-pilot/reports/impl_c/c2b_checks.sh"]
COPY = "metrix/e1-pilot/reports/impl_c/c2b_smoke_records/"
DRAFTS = ["metrix/e1-pilot/RUNBOOK_A100.md", "metrix/e1-pilot/reports/impl_c/c3_hf_tree_70d244cc.txt"]


def g(repo, *a, text=True):
    return subprocess.run(["git", "-C", repo, *a], capture_output=True, text=text, env=dict(os.environ, GIT_OPTIONAL_LOCKS="0"))


def main():
    repo, rdir, work = sys.argv[1:4]

    head = g(repo, "rev-parse", "HEAD").stdout.strip()
    print("a. HEAD %s == parent %s: %s" % (head, PARENT, head == PARENT))
    ok &= head == PARENT

    ok &= idx == tre

    ns = [x for x in g(repo, "diff", "--cached", "--name-status", "HEAD").stdout.split("\n") if x]
    print("   staged paths %d: %s" % (len(ns), sorted(set(x.split("\t")[0] for x in ns))))

    print("     (+ %d files under %straining_runs/)" % (sum(1 for x in ns if x.split("\t")[1].startswith(COPY + "training_runs/")), COPY))
    outside = [x for x in ns if not x.split("\t")[1].startswith("metrix/e1-pilot/")]
    print("   staged paths outside metrix/e1-pilot/: %s" % outside)
    ok &= not outside
    code_changed = sorted(x.split("\t")[1] for x in ns if any(x.split("\t")[1].startswith(c) for c in CODE))
    print("   staged code paths (src/, tests/, run_pilot.py): %s" % code_changed)

    q = g(repo, "diff", "--quiet", "--", *CODE).returncode
    print("\nb. working tree == index for %s: %s (git diff --quiet exit %d)" % (CODE, q == 0, q))
    ok &= q == 0
    cd = g(repo, "diff", "--cached", "HEAD", "--", *CODE, text=False).stdout
    print("   sha256 of git diff --cached HEAD -- %s: %s | == %s (c2b_03, c2b_04): %s" % (CODE, sha(cd), CODE_DIFF_SHA[:8],

    ok &= sha(cd) == CODE_DIFF_SHA
    for f in ("c2b_03_checks.txt", "c2b_04_smoke.txt"):

        shas = re.findall(r"^([0-9a-f]{64})  -$", t, re.M)

        print("   %s: code diff sha256 lines %s | 40-hex lines %s" % (f, [s[:8] for s in shas], [x[:8] for x in trees]))
        ok &= shas == [CODE_DIFF_SHA, CODE_DIFF_SHA] and SMOKE_TREE in trees

    def code_entries(t):
        return sorted(x for x in g(repo, "ls-tree", "-r", t, "--", *CODE).stdout.split("\n") if x)
    a, b = code_entries(SMOKE_TREE), code_entries(TREE)
    print("\nc. smoke tree %s: %d code entries | staged tree: %d | identical: %s" % (SMOKE_TREE[:8], len(a), len(b), a == b))
    ok &= a == b and len(a) > 0

        COPY, len(copies), work, same, diffr, missing))

    """Section 8 step 8, TEST generation (formal, on the Owner's decision): test_data.main as a subprocess with --out
    <work>/test; its output is passed through; the return code is its exit code. When the generator stopped with ST10
    (its committed ST10 record has a count over its frozen limit), the stop is a protocol stop of the pilot: the

def st10_over_limit(p):
    """The checks of the committed ST10 record over their frozen limits ([] when there is no committed record)."""
    try:
        rec, _ = R.committed_json(p.root, TG.ST10_RECORD_REL)
    except R.NotCommitted:

    return TG.over_limit(p.fz, rec.get("counts") or {})

def test_evaluate(p):
    """Section 8 step 8, TEST evaluated once (formal): the generator's preconditions again (test_data.check_preconditions:
    ST12, the committed Gate 0 and freeze records, every interpretation ruled) give the TestAuthorization; before the
    marker is written: the continuity checks, the checkpoint files of the marker's models against their committed run
    records, the base model's state hash against N's in the committed step 3 record, and ST7 with the whole TEST
    evaluation as the look-ahead (test_evaluation_seconds, from the committed step 2 record); then
    testgate.begin_test_evaluation (ST10 from the committed records, the marker committed and pushed); every model of

        step3, _ = R.committed_json(p.root, "%s/step3_record.json" % R.FORMAL_RESULTS_REL)

def begun_by_this_process(p):
    """TEST counts as begun by this process: begin_test_evaluation was called, the marker did not exist before and
    exists now (it may have raised after writing it: commit, push or the pushed-bytes check)."""
    return p.begin_called and not p.marker_before_begin and (p.root / TG.MARKER_REL).exists()


def run_test_evaluate(p):
    """The command test-evaluate. Before this process began the TEST evaluation (begun_by_this_process), a refusal
    without a stop code (a precondition of the generator, the continuity checks, a committed record or a file, the
    checkout and commit preconditions in begin) leaves no experiment record: nothing was evaluated; a protocol stop
    (ST7 look-ahead, ST8, ST9, ST10, ST12) gets one. TestAlreadyEvaluated (TEST was evaluated by an earlier run) writes
    nothing and is raised: the pilot's status is the one of its result. Once this process began the evaluation, the
    experiment record (BLOCKED for a stop or a crash, KeyboardInterrupt included) is written and committed whatever
    happens; the exception is raised again. Returns (completed without a stop, final status or the stop's status)."""
    from . import test_data as TD
    crash = None
    try:
        status, actual = test_evaluate(p)
        nxt, stop = "Owner and Review Gate read the TEST result (an E1-V1 protocol only after PASS)", None
    except (ProtocolStop, TD.PreconditionFailed) as e:
        p.close_clock()
        code = getattr(e, "stop", None)
        begun = begun_by_this_process(p)
        if not begun and code is None:
            p.log("TEST evaluation refused before it began (nothing evaluated): %s" % e)
            return False, getattr(e, "status", None)
        status = getattr(e, "status", None) or "BLOCKED"
        actual, nxt = {"stopped": str(e), "test_begun": begun}, "report to the Owner (stop %s)" % code
        stop = {"code": code, "status": getattr(e, "status", None), "message": str(e)}
        p.log("STOP (%s): %s" % ("after this process began TEST: TEST counts as evaluated" if begun
                                 else "before TEST began, a protocol stop", e))
    except TG.TestAlreadyEvaluated:
        p.close_clock()
        raise
    except BaseException as e:       # noqa: BLE001 -- a crash or interrupt after the begin is recorded, then raised
        p.close_clock()
        if not begun_by_this_process(p):
            raise
        crash = e
        status, actual, nxt = "BLOCKED", {"crashed": repr(e), "test_begun": True}, ("report to the Owner (crash after "
                                                                                    "the TEST marker)")
        stop = {"code": None, "status": "BLOCKED", "message": "crash after the TEST marker: %r" % (e,)}
        p.log("CRASH after the TEST marker (TEST counts as evaluated): %r" % (e,))
    final_record(p, "test-evaluate", status, actual, nxt, None, stop)
    if crash is not None:
        raise crash
    return stop is None, status

    the evaluation started and did not finish: it counts as evaluated, BLOCKED (Review Gate supplementary ruling 4)."""
    root = Path(repo_root)
    tip = check_checkout(root)
    where, result = _where(root, MARKER_REL, tip), _where(root, RESULT_REL, tip)
    if result:
        raise TestAlreadyEvaluated("TEST was already evaluated (marker %s in %s; result %s in %s): TEST is evaluated "
                                   "once" % (MARKER_REL, ", ".join(where) or "nowhere", RESULT_REL, ", ".join(result)))
    if not where:
        return
    raise ProtocolStop(None, "BLOCKED", "TEST evaluation was already started (marker %s in %s) and no result was "
                       "committed: it counts as evaluated; no further TEST evaluation; report to the Owner" % (
                           MARKER_REL, ", ".join(where)))


def evaluated_models(contract, selected):
    """The models TEST evaluates: N and the final checkpoints of the trained arms with every training seed (F, L, A
    with their selected configuration, the search seed's run included; S and Y)."""
    from .train import training_plan
    plan = training_plan(contract, selected)
    searched = ("F", "L", "A")
    names = [s.name for s in plan if s.arm in contract.arms.inheriting
             or (s.arm in searched and s.config_id == selected[s.arm])]
    want = len(contract.training.training_seeds) * (len(searched) + len(contract.arms.inheriting))
    if len(names) != want:
        raise ImplementationFail("%d trained models for TEST, expected %d" % (len(names), want))
    return [BASE_MODEL] + names


@dataclass
class TestSession:
    __test__ = False        # not a pytest test class
    session_id: str
    marker_commit: str
    evaluated: set = field(default_factory=set)


_LIVE = {}                  # session_id -> TestSession, only those returned by begin_test_evaluation in this process


def begin_test_evaluation(fz, authorization, data, base_model_sha256, repo_root=None, retries=4, sleep=None):
    """Start the single TEST evaluation (Review Gate supplementary ruling 4): checks (no marker or result:
    refuse_if_marker; the authorization; the ST10 gate for the TEST rows in `data`; check_commit_preconditions),
    writes the marker with every checkpoint hash of the committed freeze record plus N (`base_model_sha256`,
    train.state_sha256 of the loaded base model), commits only the marker and pushes it. Returns the TestSession."""
    from . import contract as C
    root = Path(repo_root) if repo_root is not None else fz.repo_root
    refuse_if_marker(root)
    recs = LK.verify_authorization(authorization, fz, root)
    rows_hashes = rows_hashes_of(data)
    st10_sha, aud_sha = st10_check(fz, authorization, rows_hashes, root)
    if not isinstance(base_model_sha256, str) or not FZ.HEX64.fullmatch(base_model_sha256):
        raise _refuse("base model hash %r" % (base_model_sha256,))
    freeze = recs["selection_freeze"]
    checkpoints = dict(freeze["checkpoints"], **{BASE_MODEL: base_model_sha256})
    models = evaluated_models(C.load(fz), freeze["selected"])
    check_commit_preconditions(root, "the TEST marker")
    session_id = secrets.token_hex(16)
    marker = {"kind": "test_evaluation_marker", "mode": "formal", "frozen_commit": authorization.frozen_commit,
              "authorization": auth_fields(authorization), "remote": remote_url(root, PILOT_REMOTE),
              "branch": PILOT_BRANCH, "st10_record_sha256": st10_sha, "auditor_count_sha256": aud_sha,
              "test_files_sha256": rows_hashes, "checkpoints": checkpoints, "models": models,
              "code_commit": code_commit(root), "session_id": session_id,
              "started_utc": time.strftime("%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ", time.gmtime())}
    path = root / MARKER_REL
    path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    blob = (json.dumps(marker, ensure_ascii=False, indent=1, sort_keys=True) + "\n").encode("utf-8")
    path.write_bytes(blob)
    head = commit_paths(root, [MARKER_REL], "metrix: E1-PILOT TEST evaluation marker (section 8 step 8: TEST is "
                        "evaluated once; every checkpoint hash)",
                        "the TEST marker (TEST not evaluated; the marker refuses any later evaluation)", retries, sleep)
    if _blob(root, "%s:%s" % (head, MARKER_REL)) != blob or _blob(root, "%s^:%s" % (head, MARKER_REL)) is not None:
        raise _blocked("the pushed commit %s does not hold this TEST marker alone (another TEST evaluation began at "
                       "the same time): it counts as evaluated; no TEST evaluation in this process" % head)
    session = TestSession(session_id, head)
    _LIVE[session_id] = session
    return session


def _check_session_checkout(root, session):
    """PILOT_BRANCH is checked out at the session's marker commit (no fetch: see the module docstring). So the
    committed marker, Gate 0, freeze and ST10 records are the ones begin_test_evaluation checked and wrote."""
    local = _git(root, "rev-parse", "--abbrev-ref", "HEAD").stdout.strip()
    head = _git(root, "rev-parse", "--verify", "-q", "HEAD^{commit}").stdout.strip()
    if local != PILOT_BRANCH or head != session.marker_commit:
        raise _blocked("the checkout is %r at %s, not the pilot's %r at the TEST marker commit %s" % (
            local, head, PILOT_BRANCH, session.marker_commit))


def require_test_session(fz, authorization, session, checkpoint_name, data, model, repo_root=None):
    """Called by evaluate.evaluate_model(split="test") after leakage.verify_authorization and before anything is
    evaluated (see the module docstring). Claims nothing (claim_checkpoint, after the GPU check). The model's state
    sha256 is computed last, after the cheaper checks."""
    from .train import state_sha256
    root = Path(repo_root) if repo_root is not None else fz.repo_root
    if not isinstance(session, TestSession) or _LIVE.get(session.session_id) is not session:
        raise _refuse("no TEST session of this process (begin_test_evaluation)")
    _check_session_checkout(root, session)
    marker, _ = _committed(root, MARKER_REL, "TEST marker")
    rows_hashes = rows_hashes_of(data)
    if marker.get("test_files_sha256") != rows_hashes:
        raise _refuse("the TEST rows %r are not the files of the marker %r" % (rows_hashes,
                                                                              marker.get("test_files_sha256")))
    st10_check(fz, authorization, rows_hashes, root)
    if checkpoint_name not in marker["models"]:
        raise _refuse("%r is not a model TEST evaluates (%s)" % (checkpoint_name, marker["models"]))
    if checkpoint_name in session.evaluated:
        raise _refuse("%s was already evaluated on TEST in this session" % checkpoint_name)
    got = state_sha256(model)
    if got != marker["checkpoints"][checkpoint_name]:
        raise _refuse("the model's state sha256 %s is not the marker's %s for %s" % (
            got, marker["checkpoints"][checkpoint_name], checkpoint_name))


def claim_checkpoint(session, checkpoint_name):
    """Right before the evaluation of `checkpoint_name` starts (after require_test_session and the GPU check): the
    checkpoint is evaluated at most once in the session."""
    if not isinstance(session, TestSession) or _LIVE.get(session.session_id) is not session:
        raise _refuse("no TEST session of this process (begin_test_evaluation)")
    if checkpoint_name in session.evaluated:
        raise _refuse("%s was already evaluated on TEST in this session" % checkpoint_name)
    session.evaluated.add(checkpoint_name)


def finish_test_evaluation(fz, session, result, repo_root=None, retries=4, sleep=None):
    """After every model of the marker was claimed (PILOT_BRANCH checked out at the marker commit) and the commit and
    push preconditions hold: write `result` (the TEST results, JSON values only) to RESULT_REL, commit only that path,
    push it; the session ends."""

# Mythos 项目宪章 v2.0(2026-11-08)

**本文件取代宪章 v1.0。** 与 v1.0、旧 checkpoint 或旧 PROTOCOL 文件冲突时,以本文件和 `research/mini_mythos/PROJECT_BRIEF.md` 为准。历史文件保留不改,但不再约束新工作。

## 1. 方向

- 底座是 Parcae-140M 预训练权重(`SandyResearch/parcae-140m@236739ce`)。我们不再从随机初始化训练自己的权重。
- 最终的 Mythos 是 **Parcae 的派生模型**(Parcae 权重 + 我们的机制/适配器),不是独立权重。Parcae 权重和分词器的许可证未确认,确认前不对外分发任何权重或派生模型。
- 目标:用实验证明“Parcae + 机制”优于原生 Parcae,即同等计算下质量更高,或相近质量下计算更少。不宣称复刻 Claude Mythos。

## 2. 分工与关闭

| 角色 | 职责 |
|---|---|
| 项目负责人 | 定方向、定预算、批准进入下一阶段、宣布 CLOSED |
| Claude Project(策略) | 设计和审核实验方案、解读结果 |
| Claude Code(执行) | 写代码、测试、运行、提交结果和 checkpoint |

不再要求 ChatGPT 或 Grok 交叉审核。阶段由负责人在看过结果后宣布 CLOSED。

## 3. 每个实验的最低要求

1. 一页方案,写在实验目录的 `README.md`:目的、数据、对照、主指标、通过标准、算力和时间上限、停止条件。
2. 方案提交后再运行;看到结果后不改通过标准。
3. 状态如实标注:PASS / FAIL / BLOCKED / NOT TESTED。负结果也是结果。
4. **同预算对照**:可训练参数量相同、训练 token 数相同、学习率等超参搜索次数相同。只有优于这个对照,才算机制有效。
5. **新数据**:主结论必须来自训练和调参都没用过的数据,至少包含一个异领域集;并抽样检查它与预训练语料的 n-gram 重叠。
6. 每次只加一个机制;组合要等单项都在新数据上通过。

# Metrix — 角色分工与执行规则

Metrix 是独立子项目。根目录 `CLAUDE.md`(Mythos 宪章 v2.0)第 1 节与第 3.7 节不适用于 Metrix;第 5 节「不要做」继续适用。在 `metrix/` 内,本文件与宪章冲突时以本文件为准。

本文件的修改须经 Review Gate 裁决、Project Owner 批准,并记录原因与时间。

## 1. 角色

| 角色 | 由谁担任 | 职责 | 不做 |
|---|---|---|---|
| Project Owner | Miyaji | 拍板重大事项;批准租卡与预算;在 Review Gate 与 Claude Code 之间转达 | 日常审查、代码细节 |

| Executor | Claude Code 主会话 | 写代码、运行、提交、写 SUBMISSION_NOTE、调用两个审查 subagent | 改协议、审查自己的产物、推翻审查结论 |
| Code Reviewer | subagent `code-reviewer` | 查 bug、死代码、可读性、合理性、与协议的一致性 | 修改任何文件 |
| Data Auditor | subagent `data-auditor` | 用自写脚本独立复算哈希、L1–L6 泄漏、候选可行性、split | 复用 Executor 的检查代码、加载模型权重 |

重大事项(只有 Owner 能批准):研究方向、模型、arm 结构、门槛数值、PROTOCOL_FROZEN、TEST 评测时机、租用 GPU、冻结后的协议改动、删除文件、改写 Git 历史。

## 2. 当前阶段

- E1 Pilot,状态:PROTOCOL_FROZEN（v1.1）（出处：Review Gate 第 8 轮裁决，Owner 批准，2026-11-22 09:44 UTC；作用范围：本阶段（Owner 在第 9 轮答复，见 metrix/e1-pilot/tasks/ROUND9_TASKS.md 第二段）；原因：协议已冻结并发布 v1.1 勘误版，原状态未随冻结更新，见 metrix/e1-pilot/reports/ROUND8_REPORT.md「待 Review Gate 决定」第 9 项）
- 分支:metrix-e1-pilot-protocol-v1

- 工作目录:metrix/e1-pilot/。metrix/ 以外只允许:根目录 CLAUDE.md 第 6 节、.claude/agents/ 下的两个 subagent 文件。

## 3. 硬性禁止(收到 PROTOCOL_FROZEN 之前)

- 不训练、不评测、不生成或读取 TEST 数据。

- 汇报时写明实际运行环境(主机名或环境类型),不要笼统称为「本地」。

- 改动经 PR 合入,不直接推送到受保护分支。
- PR 自动审查与本地 subagent 结论不一致时,以更严格的一方为准,并在 PR 中说明。

## 7. 必须等待人工指令的事项

PROTOCOL_FROZEN 的发出与修改、租用 GPU、生成或评测 TEST、删除任何文件、改写 Git 历史、force push。

注：「删除任何文件」不含会话临时目录；但支撑结论的输出须先提交。

## 8. 冲突处理

- Reviewer / Auditor 与 Executor 意见不同:由 Review Gate 裁决。
- 协议未覆盖的情况:停止并报告,由 Review Gate 提出方案。
- Review Gate 的裁决写入决定记录时须注明作用范围:本次提交 / 本阶段 / 永久。「永久」与「本阶段」的裁决可写入本文件,写入时须注明作用范围;「本阶段」的裁决在本阶段结束时失效。（出处：Review Gate 第 7 轮裁决（第 8 轮指令第 1e 项），Owner 批准，2026-11-22 05:27 UTC；原因：原文只允许「永久」的裁决写入本文件，与已写入的第 5 节第 6 条、第 10 节的「本阶段」裁决矛盾，见 metrix/e1-pilot/reports/ROUND7_REPORT.md「待 Review Gate 决定」第 4 项）（作用范围：永久。出处：Review Gate 第 8 轮裁决，Owner 批准，2026-11-22 09:44 UTC；原因：1e 写入时未注明这条裁决自己的作用范围，见 metrix/e1-pilot/reports/ROUND8_REPORT.md「待 Review Gate 决定」第 1 项）

## 9. 汇报格式

- commit hash 与报告路径。
- 两份审查的原始输出路径与结论。
- 所有结论附原始命令输出。自检勾选不算证据。
- 原始输出一律写入仓库并推送，不留在临时目录；data-auditor 须提交 audit 脚本的完整 stdout。（出处：Review Gate 第 4 轮裁决，Owner 批准，永久）

## 10. 信任状态

- `code-reviewer`:已验证（2026-11-21 盲测 3/3 检出、0 误报；每类仅 1 个样本，PASS 仍须附原始输出）。
- `data-auditor`:「待验证」。2026-11-21 的盲测只测了 code-reviewer;埋入已知 bug 的检出率测试通过前,其 PASS 仅作参考。
- 以上两条的出处：Review Gate 第 5 轮裁决。（出处：Review Gate 第 6 轮裁决，Owner 批准，本阶段，2026-11-22 03:25:59 UTC）

"""ic8_04 trace plugin (implementation stage C, C2 fix commit, round 1; task 3 of the invocation). Data Auditor's own code;
my ic7_04_trace_plugin.py extended for the changed code.

A pytest plugin loaded with `-p ic8_04_trace_plugin` while the Executor's test
tests/test_run_pilot.py::test_test_evaluate_end_to_end_once runs as a driver subprocess (C1 ruling item 5). It does not
check anything: it only records, in the JSONL file named by the environment variable IC8_TRACE, every call (enter /
return / raise) of the functions on the TEST evaluation path, so that my own analysis script (ic8_04_e2e.py, which
imports nothing of the Executor) can compare the observed order with the order I expected before the run. The wrappers
pass arguments and results through unchanged.

Observed (module or class attribute replaced by a pass-through wrapper after collection, before the fixture runs):
  metrix_e1.pilot: run_test_evaluate, test_evaluate, final_record, write_experiment_record (the paths it returns),
    control_evaluation, test_evaluation_seconds (its timing argument and result), Pilot.start_checks (the command);
  metrix_e1.record: committed_json, committed_record (the path read);
  metrix_e1.train.state_sha256 (the hash returned; testgate.require_test_session imports it at call time);
  metrix_e1.test_data.check_preconditions; metrix_e1.frozen.file_sha256 (only paths ending in .pt are logged);
  metrix_e1.testgate: begin_test_evaluation (its base-model hash argument), claim_checkpoint, commit_paths,
    finish_test_evaluation; metrix_e1.evaluate.evaluate_model; metrix_e1.gate: compute_test_values, judge_test,
    report_comparisons.
At the start of the test call (after the fixture; tryfirst) the plugin logs the clone, the bare remote, the work
directory, the models of the fixture, the remote's tip and the Pilot's start time (p.started, the experiment record's
file name), and wraps the fixture's own `p.before_run` (a no-op lambda the fixture installed) with a pass-through that
logs its next_seconds argument: the call and its result are unchanged.

Fault injection (IC8_FAULT, empty by default): "stop_after_marker" raises a ProtocolStop(None, "BLOCKED", ...) and
"crash_after_marker" a RuntimeError when evaluate_model(split="test") is entered for the 3rd time (after the marker was
pushed and two models were evaluated).
"""
import json
import os
import subprocess

import pytest

TRACE = os.environ.get("IC8_TRACE")
FAULT = os.environ.get("IC8_FAULT", "")
_STATE = {"installed": False, "test_evals": 0, "seq": 0}


def _log(ev):
    _STATE["seq"] += 1
    ev = dict(ev, seq=_STATE["seq"])
    with open(TRACE, "a", encoding="utf-8") as fh:
        fh.write(json.dumps(ev, default=str, ensure_ascii=False) + "\n")


def _short(v):
    s = repr(v)
    return s if len(s) <= 300 else s[:300] + "..."


def _wrap(owner, name, describe=None, result=None, only=None, label=None):
    orig = getattr(owner, name)
    label = label or name

    def wrapper(*a, **k):
        if only is not None and not only(a, k):
            return orig(*a, **k)
        info = describe(a, k) if describe else {}
        _log(dict({"call": label, "phase": "enter"}, **info))
        if name == "evaluate_model" and k.get("split") == "test":
            _STATE["test_evals"] += 1
            if FAULT and _STATE["test_evals"] == 3:
                if FAULT == "stop_after_marker":
                    from metrix_e1.errors import ProtocolStop
                    exc = ProtocolStop(None, "BLOCKED", "auditor-injected stop after the TEST marker (ic8 fault "
                                       "injection, 3rd TEST evaluation)")
                else:
                    exc = RuntimeError("auditor-injected crash after the TEST marker (ic8 fault injection, 3rd TEST "
                                       "evaluation)")
                _log({"call": label, "phase": "injected", "fault": FAULT, "exc": type(exc).__name__})
                raise exc
        try:
            r = orig(*a, **k)
        except BaseException as e:      # noqa: B902 -- logged and re-raised unchanged
            _log({"call": label, "phase": "raise", "exc": type(e).__name__, "msg": str(e)[:400]})
            raise
        _log(dict({"call": label, "phase": "return"}, **(result(r) if result else {})))
        return r
    wrapper.__wrapped_by_ic8__ = orig
    setattr(owner, name, wrapper)


def _install():
    if _STATE["installed"]:
        return
    import metrix_e1.evaluate as E
    import metrix_e1.frozen as FZ
    import metrix_e1.gate as G
    import metrix_e1.pilot as P
    import metrix_e1.record as R
    import metrix_e1.test_data as TD
    import metrix_e1.testgate as TG
    import metrix_e1.train as T
    _wrap(P, "run_test_evaluate", result=lambda r: {"result": _short(r)})
    _wrap(P, "test_evaluate", result=lambda r: {"result": _short(r[0])})
    _wrap(P, "final_record", describe=lambda a, k: {"command": a[1], "status": a[2], "stop": a[6] if len(a) > 6 else k.get("stop")})
    _wrap(P, "write_experiment_record", result=lambda r: {"paths": [os.path.basename(str(x)) for x in r]})
    _wrap(P, "control_evaluation", describe=lambda a, k: {"what": a[2], "split": k.get("split", "dev")})
    _wrap(P, "test_evaluation_seconds", describe=lambda a, k: {"timing": a[1]}, result=lambda r: {"seconds": r})
    _wrap(P.Pilot, "start_checks", describe=lambda a, k: {"command": a[1]}, label="Pilot.start_checks")
    _wrap(R, "committed_json", describe=lambda a, k: {"rel": str(a[1])}, label="R.committed_json")
    _wrap(R, "committed_record", describe=lambda a, k: {"rel": str(a[1])}, label="R.committed_record")
    _wrap(T, "state_sha256", result=lambda r: {"sha256": r}, label="T.state_sha256")
    _wrap(TD, "check_preconditions")
    _wrap(FZ, "file_sha256", describe=lambda a, k: {"file": os.path.basename(str(a[0]))}, result=lambda r: {"sha256": r},
          only=lambda a, k: str(a[0]).endswith(".pt"))
    _wrap(TG, "begin_test_evaluation", describe=lambda a, k: {"base_sha256": a[3] if len(a) > 3 else k.get("base_model_sha256")},
          result=lambda r: {"marker_commit": getattr(r, "marker_commit", None)})
    _wrap(TG, "claim_checkpoint", describe=lambda a, k: {"checkpoint": a[1]})
    _wrap(TG, "commit_paths", describe=lambda a, k: {"rels": list(a[1])}, result=lambda r: {"head": r})
    _wrap(TG, "finish_test_evaluation", result=lambda r: {"head": r})
    _wrap(E, "evaluate_model", describe=lambda a, k: {"split": k.get("split", "dev"),
                                                      "checkpoint": k.get("checkpoint_name")})
    _wrap(G, "compute_test_values")
    _wrap(G, "judge_test", result=lambda r: {"final_status": r.get("final_status")})
    _wrap(G, "report_comparisons", describe=lambda a, k: {"split": a[2] if len(a) > 2 else k.get("split")})
    _STATE["installed"] = True
    _log({"call": "plugin", "phase": "installed", "fault": FAULT})


def pytest_collection_finish(session):
    _install()


@pytest.hookimpl(tryfirst=True)
def pytest_runtest_call(item):
    c = item.funcargs.get("eval_clone")
    if c is None:
        return
    p = c["p"]
    orig = p.before_run

    def before_run(next_seconds=0.0):
        _log({"call": "p.before_run", "phase": "enter", "next_seconds": next_seconds})
        return orig(next_seconds)
    p.before_run = before_run
    tip = subprocess.run(["git", "-C", str(c["remote"]), "rev-parse", "main"], capture_output=True, text=True).stdout.strip()
    _log({"call": "test", "phase": "start", "root": str(c["root"]), "remote": str(c["remote"]),
          "work": str(p.work), "models": list(c["models"]), "remote_tip_after_fixture": tip, "started": p.started})
"""ic8_04d (implementation stage C, C2 fix commit (staged tree b40224e6, parent 1900b1fe), round 1; task 4,
supplementary dynamic evidence for the branches read statically in ic8_04_static b / e). Data Auditor's own script;
nothing of the Executor is imported. Runs two of the Executor's tests once as drivers (C1 ruling item 5) with my
pass-through plugin ic8_04d_plugin.py, which logs every subprocess.run whose command names metrix_e1.test_data:
  tests/test_run_pilot.py::test_smoke_step8_refuses_where_formal_records_exist
      my expectation: passes; NO generator subprocess is started during it (the checkout holds a committed Gate 0 record:
      step8_smoke_refusal raises ImplementationFail before subprocess.run).
  tests/test_run_pilot.py::test_test_evaluate_records_after_the_marker_and_for_st10
      my expectation: passes (its assertions: before the marker no record except for an ST10 stop; after it a record for
      a stop and for a crash, the crash re-raised); no generator subprocess.
These are the Executor's own assertions; my independent evidence for the same branches is ic8_04_static (b, e) and the
e2e runs ic8_04a-c. Expected pytest summary: "2 passed", exit 0; generator subprocess calls: none.
usage: python -I -B ic8_04d_branch_tests.py <repo_root> <venv_python> <inputs_dir> <scratch_dir (created, must not exist)>"""
import os
import sys
sys.path.insert(0, os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__)))
import json
import shlex
import subprocess
from ia_common import run

TESTS = ["metrix/e1-pilot/tests/test_run_pilot.py::test_smoke_step8_refuses_where_formal_records_exist",
         "metrix/e1-pilot/tests/test_run_pilot.py::test_test_evaluate_records_after_the_marker_and_for_st10"]


def git(d, *args):
    r = subprocess.run(["git", "-C", str(d), *args], capture_output=True, text=True, env=dict(os.environ, GIT_OPTIONAL_LOCKS="0"))
    return r.stdout


def main():
    repo, py, inputs, scratch = sys.argv[1:5]
    if os.path.exists(scratch):
        print("scratch dir %s exists: refused" % scratch)
        return False
    os.makedirs(scratch)
    trace = os.path.join(scratch, "trace.jsonl")
    open(trace, "w").close()
    print("expected (before the run): pytest '2 passed', exit 0; generator subprocess calls during the two tests: none")
    st_args = ("status", "--porcelain", "--ignored", "--untracked-files=all", "--", "metrix", ":(exclude)metrix/e1-pilot/audit")
    gs0, ix0 = git(repo, *st_args), git(repo, "ls-files", "-s")
    env = dict(os.environ, PYTHONPATH=os.path.join(repo, "metrix/e1-pilot/src") + os.pathsep + os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__)),
               METRIX_INPUTS_DIR=inputs, IC8D_TRACE=trace, PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE="1", GIT_OPTIONAL_LOCKS="0")
    cmd = [py, "-B", "-m", "pytest", "-q", "-p", "no:cacheprovider", "-p", "ic8_04d_plugin",
           "--basetemp=%s" % os.path.join(scratch, "basetemp"), *TESTS]
    print("$ " + " ".join(shlex.quote(c) for c in cmd))
    print("----- pytest stdout+stderr begin -----")
    sys.stdout.flush()
    r = subprocess.run(cmd, cwd=repo, env=env, stdout=subprocess.PIPE, stderr=subprocess.STDOUT, text=True)
    print(r.stdout.rstrip("\n"))
    print("----- pytest stdout+stderr end ----- exit %d" % r.returncode)
    ev = [json.loads(x) for x in open(trace, encoding="utf-8").read().split("\n") if x]
    for e in ev:
        print("  trace %s" % json.dumps(e))
    gen = [e for e in ev if "generator_command" in e]
    setups = [e["node"] for e in ev if e.get("event") == "setup"]
    print("tests set up %s | generator subprocess calls %s" % (setups, gen))
    passed = r.returncode == 0 and r.stdout.strip().split("\n")[-1].startswith("2 passed")
    print("2 passed, exit 0: %s | the two tests ran: %s | no generator subprocess: %s" % (
        passed, sorted(s.split("::")[1] for s in setups) == sorted(t.split("::")[1] for t in TESTS), not gen))
    gs1, ix1 = git(repo, *st_args), git(repo, "ls-files", "-s")
    print("this repository unchanged (git status audit/ excluded, index): %s %s" % (gs1 == gs0, ix1 == ix0))
    return bool(passed and not gen and sorted(s.split("::")[1] for s in setups) == sorted(t.split("::")[1] for t in TESTS)
                and gs1 == gs0 and ix1 == ix0)


run(main)
"""ic8_04d plugin (implementation stage C, C2 fix commit, round 1). Data Auditor's own code. Loaded with
`-p ic8_04d_plugin` while two of the Executor's tests run as drivers (C1 ruling item 5). It checks nothing: it wraps
subprocess.run with a pass-through that appends to the JSONL file named by IC8D_TRACE one line per call whose command
names the TEST generator module (metrix_e1.test_data), with the pytest node id of the test running; every call is
passed through unchanged (git calls included)."""
import json
import os
import subprocess

TRACE = os.environ.get("IC8D_TRACE")
_CUR = {"node": None}
_orig = subprocess.run


def _run(*a, **k):
    cmd = a[0] if a else k.get("args")
    text = " ".join(str(x) for x in cmd) if isinstance(cmd, (list, tuple)) else str(cmd)
    if "metrix_e1.test_data" in text:
        with open(TRACE, "a", encoding="utf-8") as fh:
            fh.write(json.dumps({"node": _CUR["node"], "generator_command": text}) + "\n")
    return _orig(*a, **k)


subprocess.run = _run


def pytest_runtest_setup(item):
    _CUR["node"] = item.nodeid
    with open(TRACE, "a", encoding="utf-8") as fh:
        fh.write(json.dumps({"node": item.nodeid, "event": "setup"}) + "\n")

def step3(p):
    """Section 8 step 3: N on TRAIN closed book, DEV-QA, general DEV; ST2 on G0.3."""
    (interpretation B3's ruling note: the canonical hash of train_Y.jsonl among them). TEST entries stay as they are.
    `current`: {repository path: bytes} of the two manifests as in the working tree. Returns {path: new bytes};
    raises ST12Error when anything outside the step-1 field would change."""
    dm = json.loads(current[FZ.DATA_MANIFEST_REL])
    sm = json.loads(current[FZ.SPLIT_MANIFEST_REL])
    for name in D.DATA_FILES:
        dm["files"][name].update(status=GENERATED, byte_sha256=file_hashes[name]["byte_sha256"],
                                 canonical_sha256=file_hashes[name]["canonical_sha256"])
    for name in sm["split_sha256"]:
        if name in D.DATA_FILES:
            sm["split_sha256"][name] = file_hashes[name]["canonical_sha256"]
    out = {FZ.DATA_MANIFEST_REL: manifest_bytes(dm), FZ.SPLIT_MANIFEST_REL: manifest_bytes(sm)}
    for rel, blob in out.items():
        if FZ.strip_step1_fields(rel, json.loads(blob)) != FZ.strip_step1_fields(rel, json.loads(fz.blobs[rel])):
            raise ST12Error("%s: step 1 would change it outside %r" % (rel, FZ.STEP1_FIELDS[rel]))
    return out


def evaluation_plan(contract):
    """Counts of the checkpoint overhead: model loads (N, the 30 runs, one G0.8 re-evaluation per training seed, N and
    the 15 TEST checkpoints), checkpoints saved (30), state hashes at TEST (the 16 models in require_test_session and
    N's once more in begin), TEST checkpoint files hashed before the marker (15)."""
    seeds = len(contract.training.training_seeds)
    runs = contract.arms.counts["total_training_runs"]
    test_models = 1 + len(T.ARMS_TRAINED) * seeds
    return {"loads": 1 + runs + seeds + test_models, "checkpoints": runs, "test_state_hashes": test_models + 1,
            "test_file_hashes": test_models - 1, "test_models": test_models}


def checkpoint_overhead_seconds(contract, load_s, hash_s, save_s, reload_s, file_hash_s):
    n = evaluation_plan(contract)
    return (n["loads"] * load_s + n["checkpoints"] * (2 * hash_s + save_s + reload_s + file_hash_s)
            + n["test_state_hashes"] * hash_s + n["test_file_hashes"] * file_hash_s), n


def test_evaluation_seconds(contract, pre):
    """ST7 look-ahead before the TEST evaluation begins: N loaded (load_s) and the 15 checkpoints loaded
    (load_checkpoint: reload_s), the state hashes (N twice), the 15 checkpoint files hashed, each model evaluated once
    on TEST (a DEV evaluation scaled by test / dev questions per fact, as B17). No margin is added (for Review Gate,
    reports/IMPL_C_REPORT.md). `pre`: the timing block of the committed step 2 record."""
    n = evaluation_plan(contract)
    acc = contract.accounting
    per_eval = pre["dev_evaluation_seconds"] * acc.test_questions_per_fact / acc.dev_questions_per_fact
    return (pre["load_s"] + n["test_file_hashes"] * pre["reload_s"] + n["test_models"] * per_eval
            + n["test_state_hashes"] * pre["hash_s"] + n["test_file_hashes"] * pre["file_hash_s"])

        print("  files.%-18s %s" % (n, json.dumps({k: got[DM][n].get(k) for k in ("status", "byte_sha256", "canonical_sha256")})))
    print("  split_sha256 %s" % json.dumps(got[SM]))
    print("  TEST entries unchanged from the frozen manifests: files %s | split_sha256 test_qa.jsonl %r" % (
        all(got[DM][n] == fdm["files"][n] for n in TEST_FILES), got[SM].get("test_qa.jsonl")))
    print("  train_Y.jsonl canonical in split_sha256 (B3 ruling note): %s" % (got[SM].get("train_Y.jsonl") == my_files["train_Y.jsonl"]["canonical_sha256"]))
    ok &= eq_f and eq_s and got[SM].get("test_qa.jsonl") is None
    for rel in (DM, SM):

    print("  step1_record manifests_changed %s (vs HEAD: the frozen manifests have null fields, so both would change) | "
          "manifests_already_written %s" % (s1rec.get("manifests_changed"), s1rec.get("manifests_already_written")))
    ok &= s1rec.get("manifests_changed") == [DM, SM] and s1rec.get("manifests_already_written") is False

    print("\n== E. templates (SPLIT_MANIFEST normalization)")
    T = fsm["templates"]
    bad = [t["template_id"] for t in T if normalize(t["text"]) != t["normalized"]
           or sha(normalize(t["text"]).encode("utf-8")) != t["normalized_sha256"]]
    tset = sha("\n".join(sorted(sha(normalize(t["text"]).encode("utf-8")) for t in T)).encode("utf-8"))
    print("templates %d | normalized text or normalized_sha256 differing from the manifest: %s | template_set_sha256 mine %s "
          "| manifest %s | PROTOCOL_FROZEN %s | equal %s" % (len(T), bad, tset, fsm["template_freeze"]["template_set_sha256"],
                                                           frozen_vals["template_set"],
                                                           tset == fsm["template_freeze"]["template_set_sha256"] == frozen_vals["template_set"]))
    ok &= len(T) == 32 and not bad and tset == fsm["template_freeze"]["template_set_sha256"] == frozen_vals["template_set"]

    print("\n== G. the bytes formal step 1 would write (my construction; repository layout)")
    for rel, field, new in ((DM, "files", want_files), (SM, "split_sha256", want_split)):
        frozen_b = blob(repo, FROZEN, rel)
        fobj = json.loads(frozen_b)

        nobj = copy.deepcopy(fobj)
        nobj[field] = new
        nb = (json.dumps(nobj, indent=2, ensure_ascii=False) + "\n").encode("utf-8")
        others = {k: v for k, v in nobj.items() if k != field} == {k: v for k, v in fobj.items() if k != field}
        print("  %s: frozen bytes are json.dumps(indent=2, ensure_ascii=False) + newline: %s | new bytes %d (frozen %d), "
              "sha256 %s | everything outside %r unchanged: %s" % (rel, layout, len(nb), len(frozen_b), sha(nb), field, others))
        ok &= layout and others

    listing = sorted(os.listdir(dd))
    lab = open(os.path.join(dd, "LABEL.txt"), encoding="utf-8").read() if "LABEL.txt" in listing else None
    print("listing %s | == the 8 files + LABEL.txt: %s | LABEL.txt %r | TEST file names present: %s" % (
        listing, listing == sorted(DATA + ["LABEL.txt"]), lab, [n for n in TEST_FILES if n in listing]))
    ok &= listing == sorted(DATA + ["LABEL.txt"]) and lab == SMOKE_LABEL + "\n"
    return bool(ok)

#!/usr/bin/env bash
# Implementation stage C, C2 second fix commit (staged tree a6ce8a0e, parent 0cbee197), round 1 audit: run one command and write
# its complete stdout+stderr (merged) to one file, command line first, exit code last.
#   usage: ic9_run_logged.sh <out_file> <command> [args...]
# PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 (and -B on every python call of these scripts): no .pyc file is written.
# GIT_OPTIONAL_LOCKS=0: git status in the pilot repository does not refresh (rewrite) the index file.
# Data Auditor's own script.
out="$1"; shift
export PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1
export GIT_OPTIONAL_LOCKS=0
{
  echo "# Data Auditor run (implementation stage C, C2 second fix commit, staged tree a6ce8a0ea0aeff1e86443a2a22a2a4eb349bcc50, parent 0cbee197, round 1). host $(hostname), Anthropic cloud container, CPU only (no GPU device node: $(ls /dev | grep -c '^nvidia') nvidia entries), no model weights loaded (tokenizer files only; smoke checkpoints are hashed as file bytes, never loaded; the Executor's e2e test builds random tiny models in memory); $(date -u '+%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S UTC'); cwd $(pwd)"
  echo "# stdout and stderr merged, complete, unedited"
  printf '$'; printf ' %q' "$@"; echo
  "$@"
  echo "exit=$?"
} > "$out" 2>&1
tail -n 3 "$out"

"""ic9_00 (implementation stage C, C2 second fix commit, round 1; my ic8_00 rewritten for this round): the state audited.
Read-only git commands only (no write-tree: the staged tree is compared entry by entry with the tree object named in
the review input).
  a. HEAD is the parent 0cbee197; the index entries (git ls-files -s) equal the entries of the review input's tree
     a6ce8a0e (git ls-tree -r); the full staged diff against HEAD is the diff part of review_c2c/input.diff;
     review_c2c/input_code.diff is byte-identical to `git diff --cached HEAD` of src/, tests/,
     reports/impl_c/c2_mutate_fix2.py, c2_mutate_fix2b.py and c2c_checks.sh.
  b. src/, tests/ and run_pilot.py: working tree == index (the code I run as a driver is the staged code); the sha256 of
     `git diff --cached HEAD -- src tests run_pilot.py` equals the one recorded at the start and end of
     c2c_03_checks.txt and c2c_04_mutate_fix2b.txt; the `git ls-files -s` code lines recorded there (first and last)
     equal the staged tree's code entries.
  c. The smoke (c2c_02_smoke.txt) ran on the c2c_01 tree: its recorded write-tree, code diff sha256 and ls-files lines
     (first and last) equal c2c_01's; of those code entries only tests/test_run_pilot.py differs from the staged tree
     (src/ and run_pilot.py identical blob ids); the tree object e5abf74b (if present) has the same code entries.
  d. The staged copies reports/impl_c/c2c_smoke_records/* are byte-identical to the smoke's records under
     c2c_smoke/records (index blob vs file); not copied: the per-question details only.
  e. RUNBOOK_A100.md and reports/impl_c/c3_hf_tree_70d244cc.txt are untracked and not staged (C3 drafts).
Data Auditor's own script; nothing of the Executor is imported.
usage: python -I -B ic9_00_state.py <repo_root> <review_dir> <smoke_work_dir>"""
import os
import sys
sys.path.insert(0, os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__)))
import re
import subprocess
from ia_common import sha, run

PARENT = "0cbee1978a76c82691e48516ddf97549e361fc2c"
TREE = "a6ce8a0ea0aeff1e86443a2a22a2a4eb349bcc50"
SMOKE_TREE = "e5abf74b6bf79b83a5b415bd841a25842dc6d919"
CODE = ["metrix/e1-pilot/src", "metrix/e1-pilot/tests", "metrix/e1-pilot/run_pilot.py"]
CODE_INPUT = ["metrix/e1-pilot/src", "metrix/e1-pilot/tests", "metrix/e1-pilot/reports/impl_c/c2_mutate_fix2.py",
              "metrix/e1-pilot/reports/impl_c/c2_mutate_fix2b.py", "metrix/e1-pilot/reports/impl_c/c2c_checks.sh"]
COPY = "metrix/e1-pilot/reports/impl_c/c2c_smoke_records/"
DRAFTS = ["metrix/e1-pilot/RUNBOOK_A100.md", "metrix/e1-pilot/reports/impl_c/c3_hf_tree_70d244cc.txt"]
IMPL_C = "metrix/e1-pilot/reports/impl_c/"
LS_RE = re.compile(r"^(100644|100755) ([0-9a-f]{40}) 0\t(metrix/e1-pilot/(?:src/|tests/|run_pilot\.py)\S*)$", re.M)


def g(repo, *a, text=True):
    return subprocess.run(["git", "-C", repo, *a], capture_output=True, text=text, env=dict(os.environ, GIT_OPTIONAL_LOCKS="0"))


def ls_blocks(text):
    """The `git ls-files -s` code lines of a recording, grouped in runs of consecutive lines (one block per STATE)."""
    blocks, cur, last = [], [], None
    for m in LS_RE.finditer(text):
        line_no = text.count("\n", 0, m.start())
        if cur and line_no != last + 1:
            blocks.append(cur)
            cur = []
        cur.append((m.group(1), m.group(2), m.group(3)))
        last = line_no
    if cur:
        blocks.append(cur)
    return blocks


def main():
    repo, rdir, work = sys.argv[1:4]
    ok = True
    head = g(repo, "rev-parse", "HEAD").stdout.strip()
    print("a. HEAD %s == parent %s: %s" % (head, PARENT, head == PARENT))
    ok &= head == PARENT
    idx = sorted(tuple(x.split("\t")[0].split()[:2] + [x.split("\t")[1]]) for x in g(repo, "ls-files", "-s").stdout.split("\n") if x)
    tre = sorted((x.split("\t")[0].split()[0], x.split("\t")[0].split()[2], x.split("\t")[1])
                 for x in g(repo, "ls-tree", "-r", TREE).stdout.split("\n") if x)
    print("   index entries %d | tree %s entries %d | identical (mode, blob, path): %s" % (len(idx), TREE[:8], len(tre), idx == tre))
    ok &= idx == tre
    tree_file = open(os.path.join(rdir, "tree.txt"), encoding="utf-8").read().strip()
    print("   review_c2c/tree.txt names %s: %s" % (tree_file, tree_file == TREE))
    ok &= tree_file == TREE
    diff = g(repo, "diff", "--cached", "HEAD", text=False).stdout
    inp = open(os.path.join(rdir, "input.diff"), "rb").read()
    tail = inp.endswith(diff) or inp.endswith(diff + b"\n")
    print("   staged diff vs HEAD: %d bytes, sha256 %s | contained in input.diff (%d bytes) as its tail: %s" % (
        len(diff), sha(diff), len(inp), tail))
    ok &= tail
    cdiff = g(repo, "diff", "--cached", "HEAD", "--", *CODE_INPUT, text=False).stdout
    cin = open(os.path.join(rdir, "input_code.diff"), "rb").read()
    print("   input_code.diff sha256 %s == git diff --cached HEAD -- %s (sha256 %s): %s" % (
        sha(cin), CODE_INPUT, sha(cdiff), cin == cdiff))
    ok &= cin == cdiff
    ns = [x for x in g(repo, "diff", "--cached", "--name-status", "HEAD").stdout.split("\n") if x]
    print("   staged paths %d: %s" % (len(ns), sorted(set(x.split("\t")[0] for x in ns))))
    for x in ns:
        if not x.split("\t")[1].startswith(COPY + "training_runs/"):
            print("     " + x)
    print("     (+ %d files under %straining_runs/)" % (sum(1 for x in ns if x.split("\t")[1].startswith(COPY + "training_runs/")), COPY))
    outside = [x for x in ns if not x.split("\t")[1].startswith("metrix/e1-pilot/")]
    print("   staged paths outside metrix/e1-pilot/: %s" % outside)
    ok &= not outside
    code_changed = sorted(x.split("\t")[1] for x in ns if any(x.split("\t")[1].startswith(c) for c in CODE))
    print("   staged code paths (src/, tests/, run_pilot.py): %s" % code_changed)

    q = g(repo, "diff", "--quiet", "--", *CODE).returncode
    print("\nb. working tree == index for %s: %s (git diff --quiet exit %d)" % (CODE, q == 0, q))
    ok &= q == 0
    cd = g(repo, "diff", "--cached", "HEAD", "--", *CODE, text=False).stdout
    code_sha = sha(cd)
    staged_code = sorted((x.split("\t")[0].split()[0], x.split("\t")[0].split()[2], x.split("\t")[1])
                         for x in g(repo, "ls-tree", "-r", TREE, "--", *CODE).stdout.split("\n") if x)
    print("   sha256 of git diff --cached HEAD -- %s: %s | staged tree code entries: %d" % (CODE, code_sha, len(staged_code)))
    for f in ("c2c_03_checks.txt", "c2c_04_mutate_fix2b.txt"):
        t = open(os.path.join(repo, IMPL_C, f), encoding="utf-8").read()
        shas = re.findall(r"^([0-9a-f]{64})  -$", t, re.M)
        trees = re.findall(r"^([0-9a-f]{40})$", t, re.M)
        blocks = ls_blocks(t)
        print("   %s: code diff sha256 lines %s (== mine: %s) | 40-hex lines %s | ls-files code blocks %d, each == the staged "
              "tree's code entries: %s" % (f, [s[:8] for s in shas], [s == code_sha for s in shas], [x[:8] for x in trees],
                                            len(blocks), [sorted(b) == staged_code for b in blocks]))
        ok &= shas == [code_sha, code_sha] and len(blocks) == 2 and all(sorted(b) == staged_code for b in blocks)

    print("\nc. the smoke's code state (c2c_02_smoke.txt) and the c2c_01 recording it followed")
    t2 = open(os.path.join(repo, IMPL_C, "c2c_02_smoke.txt"), encoding="utf-8").read()
    t1 = open(os.path.join(repo, IMPL_C, "c2c_01_checks_superseded.txt"), encoding="utf-8").read()

"""ic9_06 (implementation stage C, C2 second fix commit (staged tree a6ce8a0e, parent 0cbee197), round 1; supplementary to
tasks 1-5; my ic8_06 rewritten for the changed records): the smoke outputs are labelled and carry no Gate 0 conclusion
(Implementation Task Order V1 section 7), and the stop / preflight fields this fix changed.
  A. every JSON file under <smoke>/records has label "SMOKE — NOT A RESULT" and mode "smoke"; every .txt record starts
     with the label line; data/, checkpoints/, preflight/ each hold LABEL.txt with the label; exactly one experiment
     record pair experiment_record_smoke_<start>.json / .txt (file name with the start time, MINOR fix);
  B. gate0_record: NOT_TESTED with the note 冒烟测试，不构成结论, G0.1-G0.10; experiment record Status NOT_TESTED, 20
     fields; "smoke: device check skipped" (step 1 record, smoke report);
  C. the recorded "would stop" entries are exactly the value stops whose condition holds by the recorded values: ST3
     (bounds from the frozen protocol's ST3 row), ST11 now read from b17_estimate_hours (MAJOR 10: ST11 reads B17's
     estimate unchanged; the field st11_reads names it), ST2 / ST4 / ST5 from G0.3 / G0.7 / G0.6 of the smoke Gate 0
     record; no step record carries a "stopped" field (no stop propagated in the smoke; MAJOR 3's field appears only
     when a stop propagates);
  D. preflight (MAJOR 5 / 10), recomputed by me from the recorded timing block: my counts from the protocol (loads: N,
     30 runs, 3 G0.8 re-evaluations, 16 TEST models = 50; 30 checkpoints; state hashes at TEST: 16 models + N once more
     = 17; TEST checkpoint files 15), CHECKPOINT_OVERHEAD = loads x load + runs x (2 hash + save + reload + file hash)
     + 17 hash + 15 file hash, the report-only sum B17 + overhead; B17's total from its recorded parts
     (train_seconds + eval_seconds + used_seconds) / 3600; train_seconds = mean step x total_steps x (other runs +
     a_runs x a_factor) and eval_seconds = evaluation_units x DEV evaluation seconds; the TEST look-ahead that
     test_evaluate would use with this timing: 16 x (load + DEV evaluation x TEST/DEV questions per fact) + 17 hash +
     15 file hash, the questions per fact counted by me from the frozen SPLIT_MANIFEST templates (informational).
Data Auditor's own script; nothing of the Executor is imported.
usage: python -I -B ic9_06_smoke_labels.py <repo_root> <smoke_work_dir>"""
import glob
import os
import sys
sys.path.insert(0, os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__)))
import json
import re
from collections import Counter
from ia_common import frozen_json, frozen_protocol, run

LABEL = "SMOKE — NOT A RESULT"


def main():
    repo, work = sys.argv[1:3]
    rec = os.path.join(work, "records")
    ok = True
    print("== A. labels")
    js, txt = [], []
    for d, _, fs in os.walk(rec):
        for f in fs:
            (js if f.endswith(".json") else txt).append(os.path.join(d, f))
    bad = []
    for p in js:
        o = json.load(open(p, encoding="utf-8"))
        if o.get("label") != LABEL or o.get("mode") != "smoke":
            bad.append((os.path.relpath(p, rec), o.get("label"), o.get("mode")))
    badt = [os.path.relpath(p, rec) for p in txt if open(p, encoding="utf-8").read().split("\n")[0] != LABEL]
    print("JSON records %d, without the SMOKE label or mode smoke: %s | text records %d %s, first line not the label: %s" % (
        len(js), bad, len(txt), [os.path.relpath(p, rec) for p in txt], badt))
    ok &= not bad and not badt and len(js) > 0
    for d in ("data", "checkpoints", "preflight"):
        lab = open(os.path.join(work, d, "LABEL.txt"), encoding="utf-8").read()
        print("  %s/LABEL.txt %r" % (d, lab))
        ok &= lab == LABEL + "\n"
    exj = sorted(glob.glob(os.path.join(rec, "experiment_record_smoke_*.json")))
    ext = sorted(glob.glob(os.path.join(rec, "experiment_record_smoke_*.txt")))
    names_ok = (len(exj) == 1 and len(ext) == 1 and exj[0][:-5] == ext[0][:-4]
                and re.fullmatch(r"experiment_record_smoke_\d{8}T\d{6}Z\.json", os.path.basename(exj[0])) is not None)
    print("experiment records %s %s | one pair named with the start time: %s" % (
        [os.path.basename(x) for x in exj], [os.path.basename(x) for x in ext], names_ok))
    ok &= names_ok

    print("\n== B. no Gate 0 conclusion")
    g0 = json.load(open(os.path.join(rec, "gate0_record.json"), encoding="utf-8"))["gate0"]
    conds = sorted(g0["conditions"], key=lambda c: int(c.split(".")[1]))
    print("gate0_status %r note %r | conditions %s" % (g0["gate0_status"], g0.get("note"), conds))
    ok &= g0["gate0_status"] == "NOT_TESTED" and g0.get("note") == "冒烟测试，不构成结论" and conds == ["G0.%d" % i for i in range(1, 11)]
    exo = json.load(open(exj[0], encoding="utf-8"))
    ex = exo["template"]
    print("experiment record Status %r Interpretation %r | template fields %d | Experiment ID %r" % (
        ex["Status"], ex["Interpretation"], len(ex), ex["Experiment ID"]))
    ok &= ex["Status"] == "NOT_TESTED" and len(ex) == 20 and ex["Experiment ID"].endswith(
        os.path.basename(exj[0])[len("experiment_record_smoke_"):-5])
    s1 = json.load(open(os.path.join(rec, "step1_record.json"), encoding="utf-8"))
    sr = json.load(open(os.path.join(rec, "smoke_report.json"), encoding="utf-8"))
    print("device note: step1_record %r | smoke_report %r" % (s1["device"], sr["device_note"]))
    ok &= s1["device"] == "smoke: device check skipped" == sr["device_note"]

    print("\n== C. would-stop entries and step records")
    prot = frozen_protocol(repo)
    st3 = [ln for ln in prot.split("\n") if ln.startswith("| ST3 |")][0]
    st11 = [ln for ln in prot.split("\n") if ln.startswith("| ST11 |")][0]
    cb_min, acc_min = [float(x) for x in re.findall(r"< (0\.\d+)", st3)]
    hours = float(re.search(r"超过 ([\d.]+) 小时", st11).group(1))
    print("frozen protocol: %s\n                 %s\n  -> ST3 bounds Acc_CB %s, Acc %s | ST11 hours %s" % (st3, st11, cb_min, acc_min, hours))
    steps = {k: json.load(open(os.path.join(rec, "step%d_record.json" % k), encoding="utf-8")) for k in range(1, 9)}
    s4 = steps[4]["positive_control"]
    pre = steps[2]["preflight"]
    sat = {c: x["satisfied"] for c, x in g0["conditions"].items()}
    want = sorted((["ST3"] if s4["acc_cb"] < cb_min or s4["acc_dev_learned"] < acc_min else [])
                  + (["ST11"] if pre["b17_estimate_hours"] > hours else [])
                  + (["ST2"] if not sat["G0.3"] else []) + (["ST4"] if not sat["G0.7"] else [])
                  + (["ST5"] if not sat["G0.6"] else []))
    got = sorted(x["stop"] for x in sr["smoke_recorded_stops"])
    print("positive control acc_cb %s acc_dev_learned %s (step4 st3 %r) | preflight st11_reads %r, b17_estimate_hours %.4f h "
          "(step2 st11 %r) | G0.3 %s G0.6 %s G0.7 %s (step3 st2 %r)" % (
              s4["acc_cb"], s4["acc_dev_learned"], s4["st3"], pre.get("st11_reads"), pre["b17_estimate_hours"], pre["st11"],
              sat["G0.3"], sat["G0.6"], sat["G0.7"], steps[3]["N"].get("st2")))
    print("recorded 'would stop' %s == expected from the recorded values %s: %s | every entry labelled: %s" % (
        got, want, got == want, all(x["label"] == LABEL for x in sr["smoke_recorded_stops"])))
    ok &= got == want and all(x["label"] == LABEL for x in sr["smoke_recorded_stops"])
    ok &= pre.get("st11_reads") == "b17_estimate_hours"
    ok &= s4["st3"] == ("smoke: would stop" if "ST3" in want else "not triggered")
    ok &= pre["st11"] == ("smoke: would stop" if "ST11" in want else "within bound")
    ok &= steps[3]["N"].get("st2") == ("smoke: would stop" if "ST2" in want else "not triggered")
    stopped = {k: v.get("stopped") for k, v in steps.items() if "stopped" in v}
    print("step records 1-8 present; kinds %s | 'stopped' fields %s (expected none)" % (
        [steps[k].get("kind") for k in range(1, 9)], stopped))
    ok &= not stopped and [steps[k].get("kind") for k in range(1, 9)] == ["step%d" % k for k in range(1, 9)]
    st7 = steps[7]
    print("step7 smoke_stops %s | excluded %s | experiment record Stop Conditions stop %r, smoke_recorded %s" % (
        [x["stop"] for x in st7["smoke_stops"]], st7["excluded"], ex["Stop Conditions"]["stop"],
        [x["stop"] for x in ex["Stop Conditions"]["smoke_recorded"]]))
    ok &= st7["excluded"] == [] and ex["Stop Conditions"]["stop"] is None
    ok &= sorted(x["stop"] for x in ex["Stop Conditions"]["smoke_recorded"]) == want

    print("\n== D. preflight (my recomputation from the recorded timing)")
    t = pre["timing"]
    ss = frozen_json(repo, "SEARCH_SPACE.json")
    sm = frozen_json(repo, "SPLIT_MANIFEST.json")
    runs = ss["counts"]["total_training_runs"]
    seeds = len(ss["training_contract"]["training_seeds"])
    test_models = 1 + 5 * seeds                    # N + F, L, A, S, Y x 3 training seeds (protocol section 8 step 8)
    counts = {"loads": 1 + runs + seeds + test_models, "checkpoints": runs, "test_state_hashes": test_models + 1,
              "test_file_hashes": test_models - 1, "test_models": test_models}
    rc = pre["checkpoint_overhead_report_only"]["counts"]
    print("my counts %s | recorded %s | equal %s" % (counts, rc, counts == rc))
    ok &= counts == rc
    ov = (counts["loads"] * t["load_s"] + counts["checkpoints"] * (2 * t["hash_s"] + t["save_s"] + t["reload_s"] + t["file_hash_s"])
          + counts["test_state_hashes"] * t["hash_s"] + counts["test_file_hashes"] * t["file_hash_s"])
    rs = pre["checkpoint_overhead_report_only"]["seconds"]
    print("overhead seconds mine %.9f | recorded %.9f | |diff| %.3g" % (ov, rs, abs(ov - rs)))
    ok &= abs(ov - rs) < 1e-9
    p = pre["b17_parts"]
    total_steps = ss["training_contract"]["total_steps"]
    train_s = pre["summary"]["mean_seconds_per_step_excluding_first"] * total_steps * (p["other_runs"] + p["a_runs"] * p["a_factor"])
    eval_s = p["evaluation_units"] * pre["dev_evaluation_seconds"]
    b17 = (p["train_seconds"] + p["eval_seconds"] + p["used_seconds"]) / 3600.0
    print("B17 parts %s | train_seconds mine %.6f (recorded %.6f) | eval_seconds mine %.6f (recorded %.6f) | total from the "
          "parts %.9f h == b17_estimate_hours %.9f h: %s" % (p, train_s, p["train_seconds"], eval_s, p["eval_seconds"], b17,
                                                            pre["b17_estimate_hours"], abs(b17 - pre["b17_estimate_hours"]) < 1e-9))
    ok &= abs(train_s - p["train_seconds"]) < 1e-6 and abs(eval_s - p["eval_seconds"]) < 1e-6 \
        and abs(b17 - pre["b17_estimate_hours"]) < 1e-9
    s = pre["b17_plus_checkpoint_overhead_hours_report_only"]
    print("report-only sum mine %.9f h | recorded %.9f h | equal %s" % (pre["b17_estimate_hours"] + ov / 3600.0, s,
                                                                      abs(pre["b17_estimate_hours"] + ov / 3600.0 - s) < 1e-9))
    ok &= abs(pre["b17_estimate_hours"] + ov / 3600.0 - s) < 1e-9
    per_rel = {k: Counter(x["relation"] for x in sm["templates"] if x["kind"] == k) for k in ("DEV", "TEST")}
    q_dev, q_test = set(per_rel["DEV"].values()), set(per_rel["TEST"].values())
    print("questions per fact from the frozen templates: DEV %s TEST %s" % (dict(per_rel["DEV"]), dict(per_rel["TEST"])))
    ok &= len(q_dev) == 1 and len(q_test) == 1
    la = (counts["test_models"] * (t["load_s"] + t["dev_evaluation_seconds"] * q_test.pop() / q_dev.pop())
          + counts["test_state_hashes"] * t["hash_s"] + counts["test_file_hashes"] * t["file_hash_s"])
    print("TEST look-ahead with this (smoke) timing, informational: %.3f s = %.4f h" % (la, la / 3600.0))
    print("timing block keys %s" % sorted(t))
    ok &= sorted(t) == sorted(["mean_step_s", "a_factor", "dev_evaluation_seconds", "load_s", "hash_s", "save_s",
                               "reload_s", "file_hash_s"])
    return bool(ok)


run(main)

"""State of one command: frozen files, contract, mode, directories, tokenizer, data, device bookkeeping."""

    def __init__(self, mode, inputs, work, device, repo_root=None, log=None):
        self.mode = mode
        self.device = device
        self.log = log or (lambda msg: print("[%s] %s" % (utc(), msg), flush=True))
        self.root = Path(repo_root).resolve() if repo_root is not None else FZ.default_repo_root().resolve()
        self.inputs = Path(inputs).resolve()
        self.work = Path(work).resolve()
        if not outside(self.work, self.root):
            raise ImplementationFail("--work %s is inside the repository %s (data, checkpoints and TEST files are "
                                     "never committed)" % (self.work, self.root))
        self.model_dir = self.inputs / T.MODEL_CONFIG_DIR
        self.data_dir = self.work / DATA_DIR
        self.ckpt_dir = self.work / CHECKPOINT_DIR
        self.records = self.root / R.FORMAL_RESULTS_REL if mode.formal else self.work / SMOKE_RECORDS_DIR
        self.fz = STP.st12(self.root)                   # PROTOCOL_FROZEN, the four frozen files (git cat-file)
        self.contract = C.load(self.fz)
        self.determinism = CP.set_determinism(self.contract)     # protocol section 0; before CUDA is initialised
        self.started = time.strftime("%Y%m%dT%H%M%SZ", time.gmtime())
        self.device_info_record = None
        self.model_files = None
        self.ledger = CP.DeviceLedger(self.work / DEVICE_LEDGER) if mode.formal else None
        self.clock = CP.GpuClock(self.work / GPU_CLOCK) if mode.formal else None
        self.clock_opened = False
        """ST8 (formal); smoke: 'smoke: device check skipped'."""
        info = CP.check_device(self.fz, self.contract, self.mode)
        if self.mode.formal:
            self.device_name = info["name"]
        return info

    def before_run(self, next_seconds=0.0):
        """At the start of every training or evaluation run (formal): the device name against the recorded one (ST9)
        and the GPU wall-clock (ST7)."""
        if not self.mode.formal:
            return
        self.first_load()
        self.ledger.check(self.fz, CP.device_info()["name"])
        self.clock.check(self.fz, self.contract, next_seconds)

    def first_load(self):
        """Right before the first model load of this command (called by before_run and base_model): records the
        device name at the pilot's first load (section 7) and opens a GPU clock segment (a segment left open by a
        process that died is closed first, counted up to now). No CUDA device: ST8."""
        if not self.mode.formal or self.clock_opened:
            return
        name = CP.check_device(self.fz, self.contract, self.mode)["name"]
        if self.ledger.recorded() is None:
            self.ledger.record_first(name)
            self.log("device name recorded at the first model load: %r" % name)
        self.ledger.check(self.fz, name)
        if self.clock._state()["open"] is not None:
            self.clock.close()
            self.log("GPU clock: a segment left open by an earlier process was closed (counted up to now)")
        self.clock.open()
        self.clock_opened = True

    def close_clock(self):
        if self.clock_opened:
            self.clock.close()
            self.clock_opened = False

"""Stop and failure signals of METRIX E1-PILOT.

Protocol v1.1 section 9 (fixed status vocabulary) and section 11 (stop conditions). A ProtocolStop carries the stop
condition (e.g. "ST12") when one applies and the section 9 status the run must be given. Stage B (stops.py) adds the
remaining stop conditions; this module only holds the classes the data side needs.
"""

# Checked against the frozen protocol's section 9 line by contract.check_status_vocabulary (contract.load).
STATUSES = ("PASS", "HYPOTHESIS_FAIL", "IMPLEMENTATION_FAIL", "OPTIMIZATION_FAIL", "CAPACITY_LIMIT",
            "OPTIMIZATION_OR_CAPACITY_UNRESOLVED", "BLOCKED", "NOT_TESTED", "PIPELINE_NOT_QUALIFIED")


class ProtocolStop(Exception):
    """A condition of the protocol that stops the run. `stop` is the section 11 code or None; `status` is a section 9
    status, or None only for ST6 where no status is decided yet (train.NonFinite) or none applies (stops.st6 outside
    the selected configurations and the controls: the run's configuration is excluded from selection)."""

    def __init__(self, stop, status, message):
        if status not in STATUSES and not (status is None and stop == "ST6"):
            raise ValueError("status %r is not in the protocol section 9 vocabulary" % (status,))
        self.stop = stop
        self.status = status
        super().__init__("%s%s: %s" % (stop + " -> " if stop else "", status or "no pilot status", message))


class ST12Error(ProtocolStop):
    """Protocol section 11, ST12: a hash of data, manifest, template or candidates, or the model or tokenizer version,
    differs from the frozen value -> stop; BLOCKED."""

    def __init__(self, message):
        super().__init__("ST12", "BLOCKED", message)


class ST8Error(ProtocolStop):
    """Protocol section 11, ST8: the environment does not satisfy section 0 (e.g. library versions differ from
    DATA_MANIFEST.json model.libraries) -> BLOCKED."""

    def __init__(self, message):
        super().__init__("ST8", "BLOCKED", message)


class ImplementationFail(ProtocolStop):
    """Protocol section 9, IMPLEMENTATION_FAIL raised by data generation: a name stream exhausted (2.2), a distractor
    pool with too few answers (2.5), the Y / F token ratio outside its interval (2.6)."""

    def __init__(self, message):
        super().__init__(None, "IMPLEMENTATION_FAIL", message)

def final_record(p, command, status, actual, nxt, runs, stop):
    """Write the experiment record; formal: commit and push it. A failing commit or push leaves it in the working
    tree (reported; the Owner decides) and is re-raised only when the run itself did not stop.
    A formal run that stopped before step 1 began (the device check ST8, the code not committed, the commit
    preconditions of step 1) did not start on this machine: its record is written to <work>, outside the repository,
    and nothing is committed (no formal command writes into or pushes from a clone on a machine that is not the
    pilot's); the operator reports it with the log (RUNBOOK_A100.md section 4). This includes ST8 on the A100 host
    (e.g. a 40 GB card), ST12 or ST13 at the start of step 1, the continuity checks (start_checks), and ST12 in
    Pilot() itself (no Pilot, so no record at all: run_pilot.py exits with the traceback). Whether such a record
    belongs in the repository is for Review Gate (protocol section 10; reports/IMPL_C_REPORT.md).
    Records written by the run and not yet committed (a stop or crash inside a step) are committed with it."""
    if p.mode.formal and command == "formal" and not p.step1_started:
        paths = write_experiment_record(p, command, status, actual, nxt, runs, stop, outside_repo=True)
        p.log("experiment record: %s (status %s; the run stopped before step 1: not committed)" % (paths[0], status))
        return paths
    paths = write_experiment_record(p, command, status, actual, nxt, runs, stop)
    p.log("experiment record: %s (status %s)" % (paths[0], status))
    try:
        p.precommit("the experiment record")
        left = [x for x in p.uncommitted if x not in paths]
        p.commit(left + paths, "metrix: E1-PILOT formal %s experiment record (status %s)%s" % (
            command, status, "; %d records of the stopped step" % len(left) if left else ""), "the experiment record")
    except ProtocolStop as e:
        p.log("the experiment record was not committed: %s; it stays in the working tree; report to the Owner" % e)
        if stop is None:
            raise
    return paths

begun_by_this_process | 'TEST counts as begun by this process: begin_test_evaluation was called, the marker did not exist before and\n    exists now (it may have raised after writing it: commit, push or the pushed-bytes check).'

run_seconds | "ST7 look-ahead of a training run: the base model loaded, the preflight's per-step time x the contract's\n        steps (x the A factor for arm A only, as B17), the checkpoint hashed, saved, file-hashed, reloaded and hashed,\n        one DEV evaluation (0 before the preflight)."

def main(argv=None):
    a = parser().parse_args(argv)
    if a.cmd == "fetch-model":
        from metrix_e1 import frozen as FZ
        for name, sha in P.fetch_model(FZ.load(), a.inputs).items():
            print("%-40s sha256 %s (downloaded from the frozen revision)" % (name, sha))
        print("RESULT: PASS")
        sys.exit(0)
    mode = build_mode(a)
    p = P.Pilot(mode, a.inputs, a.work, "cpu" if mode.smoke else "cuda")
    if a.cmd in ("smoke", "formal"):
        ok, status = P.run_gate(p, a.cmd)
        passed = ok and (status == "PASS" or (mode.smoke and status == "NOT_TESTED"))
        print("%s %s: %s" % (a.cmd, "completed" if ok else "stopped", status))
    elif a.cmd == "test-generate":
        passed = P.run_test_generate(p) == 0
    else:
        ok, status = P.run_test_evaluate(p)
        passed = ok and status == "PASS"
        print("test-evaluate %s: %s" % ("completed" if ok else "stopped or refused", status))
    print("RESULT: %s" % ("PASS" if passed else "FAIL"))
    sys.exit(0 if passed else 1)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    run_guarded(main)

# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------- TEST evaluation end to end

SELECTED = {"F": "F3", "L": "L2", "A": "A5"}


def synthetic_test_rows(facts):
    """One synthetic question per fact (not a TEST template, not a TEST row) and four synthetic windows."""
    qa = [{"fact_id": f["fact_id"], "template_id": "SYNTHETIC_T", "question": "Synthetic question %d (not a TEST "
           "row)?" % i} for i, f in enumerate(facts)]
    general = [{"domain": "synthetic", "doc_id": "synthetic-%d" % i, "ids": [11 + i, 12, 13, 14],
                "text": "synthetic window %d" % i} for i in range(4)]
    return {"test_qa.jsonl": FZ.jsonl_bytes(qa), "general_test.jsonl": FZ.jsonl_bytes(general)}


def write(root, rel, obj):
    path = root / rel
    path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    blob = (json.dumps(obj, ensure_ascii=False, indent=1, sort_keys=True) + "\n").encode("utf-8")
    path.write_bytes(blob)
    return FZ.sha256_hex(blob)


def commit_all(root, msg):
    git(root, "add", "-A")
    git(root, "commit", "-q", "-m", msg)
    git(root, "push", "-q", "origin", "HEAD:refs/heads/main")
    return git(root, "rev-parse", "HEAD")


def clone_with_remote(fz, tmp_path, monkeypatch):
    """shared_clone on branch main with a throw-away bare repository as origin; the bare repository stands for the
    pilot's remote and main for the pilot's branch (testgate.CANONICAL_REPO, PILOT_BRANCH)."""
    remote = tmp_path / "remote.git"
    git(tmp_path, "init", "-q", "--bare", "-b", "main", str(remote))
    root = shared_clone(fz, tmp_path)
    git(root, "checkout", "-q", "-B", "main")
    for k, v in (("user.name", "metrix-test"), ("user.email", "metrix-test@invalid"), ("commit.gpgsign", "false")):
        git(root, "config", k, v)
    git(root, "remote", "set-url", "origin", str(remote))
    git(root, "push", "-q", "origin", "HEAD:refs/heads/main")
    monkeypatch.setattr(TG, "CANONICAL_REPO", TG.repo_id(str(remote)))
    monkeypatch.setattr(TG, "PILOT_BRANCH", "main")
    return remote, root


@pytest.fixture
def eval_clone(fz, inputs_dir, generated, tmp_path, monkeypatch):
    """A clone of this repository (objects shared, so the frozen commit is there) whose origin is a throw-away bare
    repository standing for the pilot's remote, branch main standing for the pilot's branch; a formal Pilot on it
    with the generated data, tiny models, committed Gate 0 / freeze / run records, checkpoints, synthetic TEST rows,
    the ST10 record and an auditor count."""
    remote, root = clone_with_remote(fz, tmp_path, monkeypatch)
    monkeypatch.setattr(E, "require_gpu", lambda mode, device: None)
    p = P.Pilot(M.FORMAL_MODE, inputs_dir, tmp_path / "work", "cpu", repo_root=root)
    p.contract = dataclasses.replace(p.contract, arms=dataclasses.replace(p.contract.arms, lora_layers=2))
    p.base_model = lambda: tiny_model(0)
    p.before_run = lambda next_seconds=0.0: None
    p.device_check = lambda: "test: device check replaced (CPU)"
    D.write(generated["files"], p.data_dir)
    facts = FZ.read_jsonl(p.data_dir / "facts.jsonl")
    plan = T.training_plan(p.contract, SELECTED)
    models = TG.evaluated_models(p.contract, SELECTED)
    checkpoints = {s.name: "b" * 64 for s in plan}
    p.ckpt_dir.mkdir(parents=True)
    for i, spec in enumerate(s for s in plan if s.name in models):
        m = p.model_for(spec)
        torch.manual_seed(100 + i)
        with torch.no_grad():
            for q in m.parameters():
                q.add_(0.01 * torch.randn_like(q))
        sha = T.state_sha256(m)
        path = p.ckpt_dir / ("%s.pt" % spec.name)
        torch.save({"label": None, "run": spec.name, "state_sha256": sha, "state_dict": m.state_dict()}, path)
        checkpoints[spec.name] = sha
        write(root, "%s/%s/%s.json" % (R.FORMAL_RESULTS_REL, P.RUNS_DIR, spec.name), {
            "kind": "training_run", "mode": "formal", "label": None, "run": spec.name,
            "checkpoint": {"state_sha256": sha, "file_sha256": FZ.file_sha256(path)}})
    write(root, "%s/step2_record.json" % R.FORMAL_RESULTS_REL, {"kind": "step2", "mode": "formal", "label": None,
          "preflight": {"timing": {"mean_step_s": 0.1, "a_factor": 1.0, "dev_evaluation_seconds": 1.0, "load_s": 1.0,
                                   "hash_s": 0.1, "save_s": 0.1, "reload_s": 0.1, "file_hash_s": 0.1}}})
    write(root, "%s/step3_record.json" % R.FORMAL_RESULTS_REL, {"kind": "step3", "mode": "formal", "label": None,
          "N": {"state_sha256": T.state_sha256(tiny_model(0))}})
    g0_sha = write(root, R.GATE0_RECORD_REL, R.gate0_record(p.fz, M.FORMAL_MODE, {"gate0_status": "PASS"}))
    content = p.fz.check_data_dir(p.data_dir)
    sel_sha = write(root, R.SELECTION_FREEZE_REL, R.selection_freeze_record(p.fz, M.FORMAL_MODE, SELECTED, content,
                                                                             checkpoints, g0_sha))
    commit_all(root, "records of steps 1-8 (test)")
    files = synthetic_test_rows(facts)
    (p.work / P.TEST_DIR).mkdir(parents=True)
    for n, b in files.items():
        (p.work / P.TEST_DIR / n).write_bytes(b)
    auth = LK.TestAuthorization(p.fz.record.commit, g0_sha, sel_sha)
    TG.write_st10_record(p.fz, auth, {"checks": {c: {"value": 0} for c in LK.TEST_CHECKS}}, files)
    write(root, TG.AUDITOR_L6_REL, TG.auditor_count_record(p.fz, FZ.sha256_hex(files["general_test.jsonl"]), 0))
    commit_all(root, "ST10 record and the auditor's count (test)")
    return {"p": p, "root": root, "remote": remote, "models": models, "files": files}
